meta.title: Reunion · light continue and persona
meta.description: Not a session mover—use DeepSeek Chat Import for full bubbles. Ordinary users: one-shot reunion_continue (import+load, ~3.5k-char brief). Also merge/separate portable personas. Share/single-session default to thread. API bills depend on cache—don’t promise fixed savings. Local exports offline; share URLs fetch public snapshots. No telemetry. Uninstall never deletes companions/.
